title: Origin story: Sundiata Keita
description: Sundiata was the son of the Mandinka king, born unable to walk, mocked as the lion's son who could not stand. When the sorcerer-king Soumaoro Kanté conquered his people, Sundiata rose, walked, and gathered the twelve kings — defeating Soumaoro at Kirina and founding the Mali Empire, with the griots singing his epic still.
